    g=[row[:] for row in grid]

    from collections import Counter

prog='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col==bg: continue
            # A frame begins at a top-left corner; try its contiguous top edge.
            w=1
            while c+w<C and grid[r][c+w]==col: w+=1
            if w<3: continue
            for b in range(r+2,R):
                if grid[b][c]!=col or grid[b][c+w-1]!=col: continue
                if not all(grid[b][x]==col for x in range(c,c+w)): continue
                if not all(grid[y][c]==col and grid[y][c+w-1]==col for y in range(r,b+1)): continue
                h=b-r-1; iw=w-2
                cells=[(y,x) for y in range(r+1,b) for x in range(c+1,c+w-1)]
                if cells and all(grid[y][x]==bg for y,x in cells):
                    fill=2 if h%2==0 and iw%2==0 else 7
                    for y,x in cells: g[y][x]=fill
                break
    return g
'''
